derivation: Calendar arithmetic by hand: 31 January plus one month clamps to 28 February 2026 (not a leap year); 28 February plus one month is 28 March, NOT the month end, so last_day(add_months(...)) = 31 March is needed for an end-of-month contract; 28 February plus one day is 1 March; datediff(1 March, 28 February) = 1; months_between(31 March, 28 February) = 1.0 because both are month ends. Incomplete period: shift_output covers 2026-03-01..2026-03-04 only, units 330+225+225+300 = 1080, 4 distinct days observed, March has 31 days, the last observed day 03-04 is not last_day(03-04) = 03-31, so the month is incomplete.
